# Slash Command Package (TypeScript)

Quickstart for creating slash commands by **MrJAwesome**.

<Cards>

  <Card href="/docs/discord-bots" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-bots/mrjawesome-slash-commands-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Example slash commands
- Command options with types
- Subcommand examples
- TypeScript best practices

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
